title: User / Input
description: Every system starts with a trigger: a person submitting a task, a form, a webhook from another tool, a scheduled run, or an email landing in an inbox.
experience: Form and dashboard inputs in React applications
Webhook and API triggers (n8n, Express)
Scheduled jobs for recurring research and checks
Task queues for long-running browser work

title: AI Orchestration
short: Plans the work and coordinates steps
description: The orchestration layer decides what needs to happen: it breaks the task into steps, chooses tools, tracks state, enforces limits, and decides when a human should approve.
experience: Planner → executor → reviewer agent loops
LangChain-based chains and agents
Step limits, retries and stop conditions
Approval gates for sensitive actions

title: LLM / Reasoning
description: Large language models read inputs, analyse extracted data, classify, summarise and produce structured outputs that the rest of the system can rely on.
experience: OpenAI and other LLM APIs with tool calling
JSON-schema / structured outputs for safe templating
Prompt design for analysis, classification and reporting
RAG over documents and extracted web content

title: Tools
short: How the system acts on the world
description: Tools give the agent hands: a browser it can drive, APIs it can call, databases it can read and write, MCP servers that expose capabilities, and external services.
experience: Playwright browser automation (navigation, extraction, screenshots)
REST API integrations and webhooks
MongoDB reads/writes as agent tools
MCP servers for typed tool access
External services: email, chat, document generation

title: Memory / Data
description: Run state, intermediate results, extracted datasets, embeddings and logs — stored so runs can be resumed, audited and improved.
experience: MongoDB for run state and structured results
File storage for screenshots and generated assets
Vector search for retrieval (currently deepening)
Run logs with per-step inputs and outputs

title: Output
description: The system ends with something useful: a report, a presentation, a dashboard update, a notification, or an action performed on another system.
experience: Automated PowerPoint / document generation
Dashboards built in React
Email and chat notifications
Automated actions through APIs and browser workflows
